messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D life simulator based on the request: “3d life simulator with Every thing doable IRL in IT. Including sentences , crime, job , économie.”

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Provide playable life-simulation systems, including crime and fictional sentencing, jobs, and economy.

## Decisions
- Created a fictional neighborhood life sim called **Daylight**, with Three.js-rendered 3D scenes, jobs and gigs, money and rent, relationships, self-care, and abstract fictional crime consequences.
- Used a single-file `index.html` implementation with external Three.js CDN import and browser local-storage saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial game UI, gameplay systems, Three.js neighborhood scene, navigation, modal interactions, and save/reset mechanics in `index.html`.
- Installed Chromium and opened the game in Playwright. Saved and inspected `screenshots/daylight.jpg`; the browser reported only a missing `favicon.ico` 404.
- Replaced `index.html` with a rewritten version after the screenshot check.

### Active
- Finish the rewritten `index.html`: its second half is incomplete; the current file ends after the `crime()` function, without scene setup, event wiring, closing script/body/html tags. The page will not yet be a complete playable game.
- Verify the completed game in the browser, including gameplay interactions and responsiveness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `index.html` by adding the location interaction/modal handlers and Three.js neighborhood setup, player controls, rendering loop, UI wiring, save/reset/help, initialization, and closing tags.
2. Run the page locally and check browser console/errors; inspect a fresh screenshot and test core interactions.
3. Report assumptions and verification results; changes are uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Main game implementation; currently incomplete after the `crime()` function.

## Important Context
- The previous `screenshots/daylight.jpg` reflects an earlier version of `index.html`, not the current rewritten version.
- Playwright browser was opened at `http://localhost:3002`; screenshot was saved to `screenshots/daylight.jpg`.
- Current working changes are uncommitted.
